name: Key Trainer
shortDescription: A typing trainer with a keyboard heat map of your weak keys.
description: Practice typing on prose or code in your own keyboard layout. The passage runs as one line while an on-screen keyboard lights the next key and flashes the one you hit by mistake. After each drill the keyboard turns into a heat map of your error rate per key, and one tap builds a drill from your weakest keys. Speed and accuracy are kept per day in your browser, with a thirty-day chart, and you can export and import your history.
setup: Your agent asks which keyboard layout you use (QWERTY, QWERTZ, AZERTY, Dvorak, or Colemak), whether you want to practice prose or code, and for a couple of passages you'd like to type, or it uses the built-in set. It can also set your name for the greeting, the drill length, and a light or dark look. No keys or accounts are needed. Your drill history stays in the browser you practice in; Export and Import in Settings move it.
